aplicacao_citacao: Sec.3.2 (p.7): 'The functional unit for this study was defined as one cubic meter of concrete at the exit gate of the precast plant'; Sec.6 (implicacoes): 'The use of PRAC in new prefabrications offers an excellent sustainable solution for precast factories'; Sec.2: 'All the samples were produced at a precast plant located in Dongguan, China'.
nota: Cradle-to-gate explicito (Sec.3.1, p.6): 'the study did not consider the environmental impacts resulting from the concrete's use at the construction site or its maintenance and replacement over time'. Nenhuma vida util declarada nem citada em todo o texto (sem ocorrencias de service life/design life/lifespan). Introducao refere elementos pre-fabricados de edificios (lajes, escadas) apenas como contexto do mercado chines.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.3.5 'Real-world applications and limitations' (p.415): materiais 'suitable for a range of structural applications, from residential buildings to complex infrastructure projects like bridges and highways' - lista generica, sem aplicacao do estudo; ensaios de laboratorio (cubos/cilindros/prismas).
nota: A analise de carbon footprint (Sec.2.3) e por m3 de HPC, sem vida util. O texto pede 'long-term durability studies' como trabalho futuro. Nenhum valor de vida util citado para o material.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.1 (p.2): 'The RC is currently used to produce wall elements at a local company'; Sec.2.4: cenarios 'realistic for most pre-fab element sites in Sweden' (betao produzido em fabrica de elementos pre-fabricados).
nota: LCA so A1-A2 (SS-EN 15978), UF 1 m3 de betao; indice de circularidade (Linder et al.) baseado em valor economico, sem componente de vida util. Nenhuma vida util declarada nem citada.

declarada.norma: EN 1992 (2004) com Anexo Nacional britanico, classe de exposicao XC3
declarada.citacao: Sec.2.1.1.2 'Service life design' (p.10-11): 'An XC3 exposure class was selected ... A design life greater than 100years was chosen for this analysis'; 'The concrete cover of the beams is in conformance with the British national annexe of the Eurocode for durability and a working life of at least 100years'; Sec.2.2.1.1 (UF): 'amount of reinforced concrete of a beam required per unit span to resist a unit bending moment with a design life greater than 100years'.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.2.1 (p.8): 'The imposed loads on the beams were selected to represent category A as specified in the Eurocode' (categoria A = areas domesticas/residenciais); vigas simplesmente apoiadas de betao armado dimensionadas no SCIA Engineer.
nota: Valor gravado (100) confirmado. Aplica-se a todas as vigas RC e SFRC (fck 30/40/50). O artigo diz 'greater than 100 years' / 'at least 100 years' (limite inferior gravado). Aplicacao 'edificio' inferida apenas da categoria de carga A do Eurocodigo; o artigo nao nomeia um edificio concreto. Fase de uso (manutencao/reparacao) fora da fronteira.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.2.2.1 (p.4): unidades funcionais = viga, pilar e 'a 10-floor concrete frame building based on a design by Bhatt et al [37]'; Resumo: 'GWP associated with making beams, columns, and a concrete building frame'.
nota: Vida util explicitamente excluida (Sec.4, p.10): 'the influence of service-life of the structure, the durability of the different mixtures, and the end-of-life effects (e.g., [48]) ... were excluded from the comparison'. O par gravado (Mix 5) e da comparacao por m3; o estudo aplica as misturas a vigas, pilares e porticos de edificio.

aplicacao_citacao: Resumo: 'Concrete mixtures, representing a feasible structural concrete for use in California infrastructure'; Sec.2.1: mistura base 'based on the 2018 California Department of Transportation (Caltrans) structural concrete specifications ... reaches 25 MPa at 28 days (CA-HC)'.
nota: Ambito so ate a producao do betao (Sec.2.2): 'they did not include consideration for construction, service life, or end of life'. Nenhuma vida util citada. Aplicacao 'infraestrutura' pela frase do proprio artigo ('California infrastructure', especificacao Caltrans); o artigo nao nomeia o tipo de obra (ponte, etc.).

aplicacao_citacao: Estudo de laboratorio de SCC M30 com cinza de lagoa (Sec.2.5/3); a introducao refere apenas como motivacao que 'In road, highway, bridge construction and large complex structures, use of self-compacting concrete has become general practice' - sem aplicacao do betao estudado.
nota: LCA cradle-to-gate da central (Sec.4.1.1: 'system boundary is up to but not including the gate of ready-mixed concrete plant'), UF 1 m3. Nenhuma vida util declarada nem citada. O texto extraido termina no Apendice B (Table B1), conteudo completo ate ao fim das paginas disponiveis.

declarada.citacao: Sec.2 (p.7): 'for this study, the system boundary includes a cradle-to-grave approach, considering a material lifespan of 100 years [46] since concrete is mainly part of the structural layer' ([46] = Brand S 1995, How Buildings Learn).

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.2 (p.7): 'the functional unit is 1 m3 of concrete used for structural purposes in housing construction in Lima, Peru, with a resistance of concrete equal to or greater than 210 kg/cm2 (20 MPa)'.
nota: Valor gravado (100) confirmado; fonte e um livro (Brand 1995), nao norma. Fase de uso nao modelada (Fig.3). Outro valor no texto (70 anos) e a vida da infraestrutura de armazenamento de agua do processo Ecoinvent, nao do betao - nao conta.

declarada.citacao: Sec.2.4 (p.5): 'an EPD was conducted following the guidelines outlined in EN 15804 and its cPCR for concrete and concrete elements [EN 16757:2022]. Accordingly, the global warming potential of the concrete production process after 100 years ... was compared'; Sec.4: 'During the 100-year use phase (B1 in LCA / EPD terminology), the C35/45 concrete containing natural aggregates has a carbonation potential of 100 kg of CO2'; Fig.4: 'CO2 uptake during 100 years life time'.

aplicacao_citacao: Betao pronto (RMC) C35/45 da EPD Velde (NEPD-2508-1250), UF 1 m3; o proprio artigo nota que 'RMC manufacturers often do not know the intended use' (Sec.2.4). Sem aplicacao declarada.
nota: Valor gravado (100) confirmado para as 3 misturas. Os 100 anos sao o horizonte da fase de uso B1 usado para a recarbonatacao, adoptado 'accordingly' as regras EN 15804/EN 16757; o artigo nao diz textualmente que a norma fixa 100 anos (alternativa: premissa_sem_fonte). A UF declarada exclui uso/manutencao (A1-A4) mas os GWP 'after 100 years' da Tab.2 descontam a carbonatacao de 100 anos.

declarada.citacao: Sec.3 + Tabela 4 'Calculated durability' (p.6): vida util calculada pelo modelo de carbonatacao de Papadakis simplificado (tempo de iniciacao + vida residual ate a perda de seccao de armadura) - originais: Variant 1 = 46,8; 2A = 380,6; 2B = 380,4 anos; modificadas: 1A = 56,5; 1B = 57,8; 2A = 50,7; 2B = 51,3 anos.

Tabela 4: Variant 2A original (C90/105, laje 140 mm, recobrimento 45 mm) = 380,6 anos; variante modificada 2A (recobrimento reduzido) = 50,7 anos.
Tabela 4: Variant 2B original (C90/105, menos armadura) = 380,4 anos; variante modificada 2B = 51,3 anos.

citadas.citacao: Sec.3 (p.6): 'Parking houses are commonly designed for service life 50 years.' - alvo para o qual as variantes foram reajustadas ('adjusted to reach the end of service life approximately 50 years, not lower').

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.1 (p.1): 'A case study was performed for chosen structure - a floor structure of a parking house with slab spanning 5.4 m supported by beams'.
nota: Valores gravados (46,8 / 380,6 / 380,4) confirmados como vidas uteis das variantes ORIGINAIS (Tab.4, Fig.1). O artigo tambem calcula variantes MODIFICADAS para ~50 anos (1A 56,5; 1B 57,8; 2A 50,7; 2B 51,3) avaliadas de novo na LCA (Fig.2) - confirmar se o CO2 gravado de cada par vem da Fig.1 (originais) ou da Fig.2 (modificadas), porque a vida util tem de ser a da mesma variante. O alvo de 50 anos nao tem fonte citada (base 'literatura' usada so por falta de categoria; e afirmacao dos autores).
